welcome.title: Be the place pet owners choose.
welcome.body: Ragly is the pet app for vaccines, reminders, and health notes. The business side is where clinics, groomers, pharmacies, and pet shops publish a profile. Pet owners discover that profile in the app. You manage it here.
welcome.step1_body: Use the same Ragly login as the mobile app. A pet owner account can request a business too.
welcome.step2_body: You fill in the public details. We review the request before it can appear in the app.
welcome.step3_body: After approval, your business shows in the Ragly app under its category.
welcome.publish_body: If you run a real pet business, create an account or log in and send it for review. We check the listing the way an app store checks an app. After we approve it, pet owners can find you in Ragly.

siteLegal.privacy_intro: This policy covers the Ragly for Business website. The Ragly mobile app has its own privacy policy. The same account works in both.
siteLegal.privacy_s1_body: The website is operated by the Ragly team in Israel. Privacy requests: support@ragly.cloud.
siteLegal.privacy_s2_body: It covers accounts and business listings created on this website. Pet records, reminders, photos of pets, and subscriptions are covered by the mobile app privacy policy.
siteLegal.privacy_s3_body: We collect your email address and a one-time verification code when you create or sign in to an account. If you send a business for review, we collect what you enter: business name, phones, email, description, category, address, opening hours, website, Instagram, photos, and map location. If you choose a language, we store that choice in a cookie on this browser.
siteLegal.privacy_s4_body: After we approve a listing, pet owners can see it in the Ragly app. That includes the business name, category, description, address, hours, phone, website, Instagram, photos, and map location. Reviews that pet owners write in the app can appear with that listing.
siteLegal.privacy_s5_body: We use this information to sign you in, review the listing, show an approved profile in the app, keep the service secure, and reply to support. We do not sell personal information.
siteLegal.privacy_s6_body: This website sets one cookie, and only after you choose a language. It remembers that choice. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies on this website.
siteLegal.privacy_s7_body: Google Firebase signs you in. MongoDB stores the account and the listing. Resend sends the verification email. Cloudflare hosts this website. Google Cloud hosts the API. They process the data only to provide those services.
siteLegal.privacy_s8_body: We keep the account and the listing while they are active. You can delete a business from the dashboard. To delete the whole Ragly account, use the Delete account page or email support@ragly.cloud. We delete or anonymize associated personal data within 30 days, except limited records we must keep for legal, security, or accounting reasons.
siteLegal.privacy_s9_body: You can ask to access, correct, or delete your personal data by emailing support@ragly.cloud. Where the law where you live gives you more rights, such as objecting to a use or complaining to a privacy authority, you can use them. We respond to verified requests within a reasonable time.
siteLegal.privacy_s10_body: This website is for people who run a pet business. It is not directed to children under 13, or under the higher age your country requires. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child sent us personal data, email support@ragly.cloud.
siteLegal.privacy_s11_body: We use safeguards appropriate to this data, including encrypted transport and access controls. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure.
siteLegal.privacy_s12_body: Your information may be processed in countries where we or our providers operate, including outside Israel. We take steps designed to protect it in line with this policy.
siteLegal.privacy_s13_body: We may update this policy. The date at the top changes when we do. Continued use of the website after an update means you accept the revised policy.
siteLegal.terms_intro: These terms cover the Ragly for Business website. By using it, you agree to them. The Ragly mobile app has its own terms, and those apply when you use the app.
siteLegal.terms_s1_body: The site lets a pet business create an account and send a public profile for review. After we approve it, pet owners can find that profile in the Ragly app. We may update, suspend, or change the website.
siteLegal.terms_s2_body: You need a valid email. You are responsible for keeping access to that email and for activity on the account. One person may own more than one business. Provide accurate information.
siteLegal.terms_s3_body: Send only a real pet business, with details that are accurate and that you have the right to publish. Address, hours, and phone must match the place pet owners will visit. We may reject, edit, suspend, or remove a listing. Approval is not guaranteed. An approved listing is not an endorsement and not a promise that the business is open, licensed, or suitable.
siteLegal.terms_s4_body: Pet owners may review a published business in the Ragly app. We may remove a review that breaks the app rules. You may not pressure someone to change or remove an honest review.
siteLegal.terms_s5_body: You keep ownership of the text and photos you upload. You give Ragly permission to store them and to show the approved profile, including in the app.
siteLegal.terms_s6_body: Do not misuse the site, interfere with it, attempt to access someone else's account, or upload content you do not have the right to share. Do not use the site in a way that breaks the law.
siteLegal.terms_s7_body: Ragly is not a veterinary service. A listing, a review, or anything on this website is not veterinary advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
siteLegal.terms_s8_body: The website is provided as is and as available. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we disclaim warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. We do not warrant that the site will be uninterrupted or that a listing will be approved.
siteLegal.terms_s9_body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Ragly and its operators are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for loss of data, profits, or the dealings between a pet owner and a business.
siteLegal.terms_s10_body: We may suspend or close an account, or remove a listing, if these terms are broken or if we need to do so for security or legal reasons.
siteLegal.terms_s11_body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Israel, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Courts in Israel have exclusive jurisdiction, unless mandatory consumer law in your country says otherwise.
siteLegal.terms_s12_body: We may update these terms. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
